meaning:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.10
§ Bigtha = "in the wine-press"
a eunuch in king Ahasuerus' (Xerxes) court

elsewhere.note: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcass, the seven…
